checks.title: Split is fixed, plot-disjoint and consistent with its own config
detail: seed 20261011, grouped on PLOT_ID, stratified by plot-mean yield tercile
131 plots; plots appearing in more than one split: 0
train  197 field-seasons,  80 plots
val     60 field-seasons,  24 plots
test    62 field-seasons,  27 plots
the split file predates every artefact that consumes it
NOTE, and it is a real limit rather than a leak: the satellite model in
the shipped hybrid is fitted on train+val, so test rows are out-of-sample
for it, but the FEATURE SET and the model family were chosen while looking
at val. The test split is held out from fitting, not from every design
decision ever made. Only src/confirmatory.py was frozen in that stronger
sense, and it FAILED both its primary criteria.

checks.title: Hybrid and last-harvest compared on identical splits, labels and metrics
detail: coverage: 188 field-seasons have causal history, 188 have a last harvest (identical sets)
held-out test split: n=62, losses=11, satellite=shipped model
hybrid 0.807 | last harvest 0.803 | history mean 0.797
paired hybrid - last harvest = +0.004, 95% CI [-0.092, +0.078]  -> INCONCLUSIVE
all field-seasons, out-of-fold: n=319, losses=53, satellite=out-of-fold
hybrid 0.824 | last harvest 0.838 | history mean 0.838
paired hybrid - last harvest = -0.014, 95% CI [-0.059, +0.024]  -> INCONCLUSIVE
WHAT DIFFERS: on the 188 field-seasons that have a record, the hybrid uses
the MEAN of all prior harvests and the baseline uses the LAST one; on the
131 without a record the hybrid falls back to satellite and
the baseline to the area average. The comparison is therefore fair but
conflates two choices, which is why history mean is shown alongside.

checks.title: Flagged-versus-unflagged denominators, interval method and clustering
detail: held-out test split: 62 field-seasons at 27 plots
denominators: flagged 20 (8 bad), unflagged 42 (3 bad); 20+42=62 = n OK
budget realised 32.3% against a 33% target
difference in share below threshold +32.9%, 95% CI [+1.1%, +62.4%]
interval method: percentile bootstrap, 10000 replicates, resampling PLOTS and carrying every season of a plot together
replicates discarded as degenerate (one side empty): 0 of 10000 = 0.00%
all field-seasons: 319 field-seasons at 131 plots
denominators: flagged 105 (45 bad), unflagged 214 (8 bad); 105+214=319 = n OK
budget realised 32.9% against a 33% target
difference in share below threshold +39.1%, 95% CI [+26.1%, +51.5%]
interval method: percentile bootstrap, 10000 replicates, resampling PLOTS and carrying every season of a plot together
replicates discarded as degenerate (one side empty): 0 of 10000 = 0.00%
CAVEAT the numbers cannot carry: the target is yield below 80% of a
training-split mean on FARMER-RECALLED yield. An association with that
label is not evidence of detecting crop damage.
